page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmhfr6.20xlarge is an ECS Bare Metal instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor based on the x86_64 architecture. The server provisions 80 dedicated vCPUs operating at a nominal clock frequency of 3.1 GHz. As a bare-metal hardware implementation integrated with KVM-based infrastructure, it delivers dedicated CPU resource allocation without the resource contention typical of virtualized multi-tenant environments.

The instance is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, resulting in an allocation of 9.6 GB per core. Network connectivity is supported by a 32 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The system includes no integrated local storage drives, meaning all primary storage volumes must be mounted via network-attached cloud disks. Additionally, the instance contains no dedicated GPU accelerators.

Given its high memory-to-vCPU ratio and multi-core configuration, ecs.ebmhfr6.20xlarge is primarily structured for memory-intensive operations. Suitable workloads include large in-memory databases, caching tiers, real-time analytics, and high-density enterprise ERP applications. However, organizations operating I/O-intensive workloads should consider that storage throughput remains bound to the performance limits of network-attached storage infrastructure due to the complete lack of local NVMe storage.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmhfr6.20xlarge is a memory-optimized bare metal server powered by the x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 3.1 GHz. The instance delivers 80 dedicated vCPUs alongside 768.0 GB of system memory, establishing an expansive 9.6 GB memory-per-core ratio. Network capabilities feature a 32 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, accommodating heavy data transmission across cloud networks. The server configuration contains no onboard local storage drives and omits hardware GPU acceleration, necessitating external networked block storage for operating system and data volumes. Given its combination of high CPU core counts and massive memory footprint, ecs.ebmhfr6.20xlarge is suited for in-memory databases, real-time data processing engines, large enterprise workloads, and data warehouse analytics where extreme RAM density and dedicated bare-metal execution are primary operational requirements.
